source.label: IBM の公式サイト(ibm.com/samsung)
source.quote: Foundry partner Samsung Foundry manufactures the new IBM Telum® II processors and IBM Spyre™ Accelerators for the next-generation IBM Z® systems.

relations.text: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72のAIスーパーコンピューターをIBMへ納入し、IBMがGraniteモデルの学習に利用
relations.text_en: To deliver an NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 AI supercomputer to IBM for training Granite models

source.label: IBM ニュースルーム(2025年1月)
source.quote: IBM will use CoreWeave’s highly performant, reliable, and resilient cloud platform to train the next generations of its Granite models
source.note: 発表時点では計画の段階でした。

relations.text: 量子コンピューターとスーパーコンピューターを組み合わせた次世代の計算基盤を共同で開発する計画
relations.text_en: Plans to develop quantum-centric supercomputing architectures together

source.label: IBM ニュースルーム(2025年8月)
source.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM ) and AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) announced plans to develop next-generation computing architectures based on the combination of quantum computers and high-performance computing, known as quantum-centric supercomputing.

relations.text: GPUを使ったデータ分析・文書処理・インフラ・クラウドなどで協業を拡大
relations.text_en: Expanded collaboration on GPU-native analytics, document processing, infrastructure and cloud

source.label: IBM ニュースルーム(2026年3月)
source.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM ) today announced at GTC 2026 an expanded collaboration with NVIDIA to help enterprises operationalize AI at scale.

relations.text: IBMのソフトウェアにClaudeを組み込む戦略的提携
relations.text_en: Strategic partnership to integrate Claude into select IBM software

source.label: IBM ニュースルーム(2025年10月)
source.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM) and Anthropic today announced a strategic partnership to accelerate the development of enterprise-ready AI by infusing Anthropic’s Claude

relations.text: ネットワークでつないだ分散型量子コンピューターの基盤づくりで協力する意向
relations.text_en: Intention to collaborate on networked distributed quantum computing

source.label: IBM ニュースルーム(2025年11月)
source.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM ) and Cisco (NASDAQ: CSCO) announced an intention to collaborate on the groundwork for networked distributed quantum computing
source.note: 意向の表明で、5年以内の実証を目標としています。
source.note_en: An intention; a proof of concept is targeted within five years.

source.quote: ServiceNow will also incorporate watsonx.ai and IBM Granite foundation large language models (LLMs) into its Now Assist GenAI experience for ServiceNow customers.

relations.text: KyndrylはIBMから分離独立した会社。IBMの製品をKyndrylのサービス契約経由で使う顧客からの収益は、関係の変化に伴い減少
relations.text_en: Kyndryl states it was spun off from IBM and that revenue from customers consuming IBM content through Kyndryl service contracts has declined as the relationship evolves

source.label: Kyndryl 10-K(2026年度)(2026年3月)
source.quote: as our relationship with IBM following the Spin-off continues to evolve, the amount of revenue generated by customers consuming IBM’s content through our service contracts has declined and may continue to decline

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
